_comment: The interim plan of Débogage's « Lancer le field report (tous les tests) » on Windows only: the checks windows/diagnostics/ui/field_check/run_all.ahk runs one after the other until the Windows driver hands its own field run session the steps in-app, as macOS and Linux already do (their diagnostics/engine/field_run/field_run.lua Session:submit_in_app; TODO.md « Lancer le field report », Windows). Delete this file with that change.

run: each entry names a step of windows/diagnostics/data/field_run_steps.json, whose check and deadline_seconds the run uses; row is the Tests row that starts the same check alone, when there is one. separate: the Tests rows a person must run, listed in the report as « run separately ». tools/test/test-field-check-all-plan.cjs fails when a Windows Tests row is in neither list or a step is not a field check of that file.
